name: Town Square
description: An open town square with a stone fountain at its center. Wooden benches surround the fountain. A few pigeons peck at crumbs on the cobblestone ground. This is where the townsfolk come to relax and chat.

items.name: Stone Fountain
items.description: A weathered stone fountain with water trickling from a cherub statue at the top.

items.name: Community Notice Board
items.description: A wooden notice board with various flyers, lost pet posters, and local event announcements.

conditions.description: An open outdoor area with good visibility. The fountain creates a pleasant ambient sound.
